metadata.name: AI Code Orchestration
metadata.description: Inspect parent tasks, subtasks, Agent roles and scoped JSON, and read the complete orchestration Skill.

connection.detail: Demand sync, Agent claims and execution are not connected yet. You can read the Skill and configure default concurrency limits.
connection.loadingDetail: Please wait while settings and tasks load.
connection.errorDetail: Check that Feedback Board is installed, enabled and its service dependency is allowed, then retry. Existing tasks are not reset.
connection.forbiddenDetail: Your identity does not have access. Contact a team administrator.

board.hint: Planned demands enter the pool · Open a parent task to see its subtasks
board.label: Global parent-task board
board.detailHint: Only this parent’s subtasks · Completion requires every subtask to pass testing and merge
board.waitingSplitDetail: The orchestrator decomposes the demand and starts Workers within the available concurrency quota.
board.waitingClaimDetail: The planned demand is in the pool. Orchestration starts after a successful Agent Lock.
board.withdrawn: Source is no longer planned; existing work is retained

roles.hint: Shared role pool · Only running Agents count. Work or test completion automatically returns capacity.
roles.unconnected: These are local default settings for the future task service. Running counts are not available yet.
roles.retained: Completed instances remain in history and do not consume capacity
roles.noRuntime: Agent execution integration is not available
roles.invalidLimit: Enter a non-negative integer no lower than the current running count.
roles.saveFailed: Save failed. The existing settings were preserved. Try again.
roles.connectionHint: Give this line to an Agent on the same computer. Keep its token private. Reconnect after quitting the App or changing accounts.
roles.connectionPrompt: Use this local orchestration service: POST the method and input JSON object to endpoint with the token as Bearer authorization; read the returned Skill and follow the assigned role. Never print the token. Connection:
roles.connectionFailed: Cannot issue a connection. Check gateway permission and current login.
roles.connectedLimits: Applies immediately to concurrent execution. The limit cannot be below the current running count.

api.hint: Administrator inspection · Agents receive only JSON within their authorized scope
api.readonly: This is an administrator inspection view. Real writes require an authenticated Agent.
api.emptyHint: Once Agent execution is connected, this view will show real identities and their assigned tasks.

skill.title: Help Agents understand the board and collaborate by role
skill.intro: Includes board principles, features, role rules and interface guidance. The complete content ships with the plugin; no preview server is needed.
skill.prompt: Use $ai-code-orchestration. First verify the connection and authorized identity, then read my assigned tasks. Prepare drafts only when no service is connected.
skill.selected: Selected. Use your system copy shortcut to copy.
skill.promptHint: The instruction works with tools that have this Skill installed. Otherwise, give the Agent the complete content below.
skill.principlesDetail: The relationship between human demands, parent tasks and subtasks, plus Agent Lock and concurrency quotas.
skill.rolesDetail: Orchestrators decompose and assign. Workers deliver. Testers validate independently.
skill.interfacesDetail: Read JSON, submit permitted fields, handle conflicts and retries, and verify the actual connection.
skill.statusDetail: Tasks are stored by this App. Create an orchestrator connection in Roles and pass its one-line instruction to an Agent on this computer. Workers and Testers use separate connections and report execution and Git evidence.
skill.language: The Skill document is currently in Chinese. Both UI languages provide the same complete instructions.

archive.instructions: Copy the complete JSON and save it to your own file. After confirming the backup, you can remove local execution details. The task and feedback source remain to prevent duplicate intake.
archive.saved: I saved the complete backup to a file and confirm removal of local execution details
archive.done: Execution details are in your backup
archive.retained: The task source and backup digest remain here. Consult your saved JSON for delivery, test and merge reports.
archive.failed: Operation did not finish. Reopen the task and export a fresh backup before retrying.
archive.cleanupPending: Task archived; some hidden evidence files could not be removed. Active tasks are unaffected.
